video_goal: Demonstrate how to navigate ProtonMail settings to enable and configure an out-of-office auto-reply for international travel.
required_subjects_and_props: Computer monitor, ProtonMail desktop web interface, mouse cursor, keyboard

outline_steps.visual_action: Screen capture of the ProtonMail desktop inbox interface. The mouse cursor glides from the center of the screen to the top-right corner, hovering over the Settings gear icon.
The cursor clicks the Settings gear icon, causing a quick-settings dropdown menu to appear on the right side of the screen.
The cursor moves down the dropdown menu and clicks the 'All settings' button.
The interface transitions to the Settings dashboard. The cursor moves to the left-hand navigation sidebar and hovers over the 'Auto-reply' menu item.
The cursor clicks 'Auto-reply', and the main right-hand panel updates to display the Auto-reply configuration settings.
The cursor clicks the toggle switch next to 'Auto-reply', changing it from a grey 'off' state to a purple 'on' state.
The cursor moves down to the 'Duration' section and clicks the 'Start date' text field, prompting a calendar widget to pop up.
The cursor clicks on a specific date number on the calendar widget, then clicks a time slot in the adjacent time dropdown.
The cursor clicks the 'End date' field, opening the calendar again, and selects a date two weeks later.
The cursor moves down to the rich text editor box labeled 'Message' and clicks inside it, making a blinking text cursor appear.
Text rapidly appears in the editor box, spelling out: 'I am currently on international travel in a different time zone with limited connectivity.'
The cursor clicks and drags to highlight the words 'international travel', then moves up to the formatting toolbar and clicks the 'B' (Bold) icon.
The cursor scrolls to the bottom of the Auto-reply configuration panel and clicks the solid purple 'Save' button.
A green notification banner with a checkmark and the text 'Auto-reply saved' slides up from the bottom center of the screen.
